Lochia.6: Nyuma yo kubyara, lochia ni amazi asohoka mu gitsina ahambiriye n'umuvuduko w'umuhango wo koroherwa kw'igitereko. Ibara ryayo n'ingano yayo bihinduka buhorobuhoro mu minsi n'ibyumweru bikurikira.
Lochia.12: Ni ryari wokwiye gusaba inama z'ubuvuzi?
Lochia.15: Lochia ni amazi asohoka mu gitsina agaragara nyuma yo kubyara. Cane cane ni ugusohoka buhorobuhoro kw'amaraso, amazi n'ibitambaro vyo mu gitereko igihe kirimo kuroherwa.
Lochia.16: Itandukanye n'imihango isanzwe. Itegerejwe mu gihe c'inyuma yo kubyara kandi isanzwe igabanuka buhorobuhoro.
Lochia.18: Lochia ntivuga ko imihango yawe yamaze gusubira. Isubira ry'imihango ni ikindi kintu kiba nyuma.
Lochia.19: 2. Lochia ihinduka gute uko igihe gihita?
Lochia.20: Isura yayo isanzwe ihinduka mu byumweru bike bya mbere. Ibara rirushiriza koroha buhorobuhoro kandi ingano igira kugabanuka.
Lochia.22: Ibice birashobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi
Lochia.25: Amazi asanzwe atukura kandi ashobora kuba menshi mu ntangiriro.
Lochia.28: Ibara rirushiriza koroha buhorobuhoro kandi rishobora kuja kuri roza canke ikayuka.
Lochia.31: Amazi asanzwe arushiriza koroha, afise umuhondo canke yera, imbere yo gushira.
Lochia.33: Ukuntu lochia ihinduka ntibiba bimwe ku bose. Impinduka zimwezimwe zishobora kuherekeza mu buryo bw'umuhango koroherwa nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.35: Ingano ishobora guhinduka mu minsi mike ya mbere hanyuma ikagabanuka buhorobuhoro.
Lochia.37: Lochia isanzwe iva ku gitukura ikaja ku mabara yoroshe uko igihe gihita.
Lochia.39: Ishobora kumara ibyumweru bitari bike, kandi uko ihinduka kuratandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
Lochia.40: 4. Impanuro zo kumererwa neza no gukurikirana
Lochia.41: Muri iki gihe, gukurikirana koroshe bishobora kugufasha kurabira ukuntu umubiri wawe uhinduka utagereranya ivyo uciyemwo n'ivy'undi.
Lochia.43: Hitamwo kwoza buhoro, buri kanya, utarimwo ibicuruzwa birakaza.
Lochia.45: Ushobora kwandika ibara, ingano n'ukuntu amazi ahinduka nimba bigufasha gukurikirana koroherwa kwawe.
Lochia.47: Igihe c'inyuma yo kubyara gisaba igihe. Umvira umubiri wawe kandi wubahirize ukeneye koroherwa.
Lochia.49: Lochia igaragara mu minsi ikurikira kubyara kandi igabanuka buhorobuhoro. Isubira ry'imihango yawe, naho, rihuye no gusubira kw'uruziga rwawe rw'imihango nyuma y'iki gihe.
Lochia.51: Amazi ahambiriye n'ukoroherwa kw'igitereko nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.53: Gusubira kw'uruziga rw'imihango, mu gihe gitandukanye hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
Lochia.54: 6. Ni ryari wokwiye gusaba inama z'ubuvuzi?
Lochia.55: Nimba uko bigenda bigusa n'ibitari ibisanzwe, canke nimba uko umeze muri rusangi kurushiriza kuba kubi, ni ngombwa gusaba inama umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.
Lochia.58: Umuriro canke uko umeze muri rusangi kurushiriza kuba kubi
Lochia.59: Amaraso ahise aba menshi cane gitunguranye
Lochia.63: Lochia isanzwe ihinduka buhorobuhoro: ishobora kuba itukura mu ntangiriro, hanyuma ikarushiriza koroha imbere yo gushira. Ariko, koroherwa kwa buri muntu kurihariye.
Lochia.65: Lochia ni amazi asanzwe nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.66: Isanzwe ihindura ibara n'ingano mu byumweru.
Lochia.67: Igihe imara n'uko ihinduka bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
Lochia.68: Umunuko udasanzwe, umuriro, ububabare bukomeye, canke kuva amaraso menshi cane gitunguranye bisaba inama z'ubuvuzi.
Lochia.69: Ibikubiyemwo vyo kumenyesha. Iyi ngingo ntisubira inama z'ubuvuzi canke isuzuma. Nimba ufise amakenga canke ubonye ikimenyetso gihangayikishije, saba inama umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.
Lochia.70: Gusobanukirwa lochia nyuma yo kubyara — AWA

MedicalExams.6: Ultrasound n'ibizamini by'ingenzi, igice ku gice cy'amezi atatu.
MedicalExams.13: Igitigiri gisanzwe kirimwo ultrasound eshatu nkuru, imwe kuri buri gice c'amezi atatu, buri imwe ifise intego itandukanye.
MedicalExams.14: Igice ca 1 c'amezi atatu: kumenya amatarike na nuchal translucency
MedicalExams.15: Igice ca 2 c'amezi atatu: ultrasound y'ishusho y'umwana
MedicalExams.16: Igice ca 3 c'amezi atatu: gukura n'ukuntu umwana ari
MedicalExams.17: Ibizamini vy'amaraso bisanzwe bikurikirana ibimenyetso vy'ingenzi vyinshi mu gitigiri cose:
MedicalExams.18: Urugero rw'icuma, kugira ngo hamenyekane ubuke bw'amaraso bushoboka
MedicalExams.19: Gupima diyabete y'igitigiri, isanzwe ahagana mu gice ca 2 c'amezi atatu
MedicalExams.20: Ubwoko bw'amaraso no gupima antikorps zidasanzwe
MedicalExams.21: Ibizamini bya serology (toxoplasmosis, rubella) bitewe n'ukuntu umubiri wawe urinda indwara
MedicalExams.22: Andika ibibazo vyawe uko bikuzaho, imbere y'uko wibagira
MedicalExams.23: Zana agatabo kawe ko gukurikirana igitigiri igihe cose ubonana na muganga
MedicalExams.24: Bwira ikimenyetso cose gishasha, naho cogaragara nk'icoroshe
MedicalExams.25: Ingano nyayo n'ingengabihe y'ibizamini bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ubuvuzi bwawe, urugero rw'ingorane zawe, n'imigenzo y'igihugu canke y'uwuguvura.
MedicalExams.27: Ntutinye kwandika ibibazo vyawe imbere y'igihe cose ubonana na muganga kugira ngo utagira ico wibagirwa muri ako kanya: nta kibazo kiri gito cane ku buryo kitabazwa.

MenopauseHormones.6: Igihe menopause yegereje, hormone zawe ntizihagarara gitunguranye: zirahinduka-hinduka, ico gisobanura impinduka z'uruziga n'ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibimenyetso bishoboka.
MenopauseHormones.9: Biba gute mu gihe cya perimenopause?
MenopauseHormones.21: Hormone eshatu nkuru zihinduka muri iki gihe c'inzibacyuho, buri imwe ifise uruhara rutandukanye:
MenopauseHormones.23: Igira ingaruka ku ruziga, uruhu, amagufa, umutima, kandi igice igenga ugusinzira n'umutima.
MenopauseHormones.25: Ikorwa nyuma ya ovulation, igira ingaruka ituza kandi itegura umubiri ku gitigiri gishoboka.
MenopauseHormones.27: Zigengwa n'ubwonko, zikangura intanga ngore; urugero rwazo ruhinduka uko intanga ngore zisubiza mu buryo butandukanye.
MenopauseHormones.29: Urugero rwa hormone ntirugabanuka mu buryo bugororotse neza mu gihe cya perimenopause: rushobora guhinduka-hinduka, kuzamuka no kumanuka, imbere yo gutekana ku rugero ruri hasi nyuma ya menopause.
MenopauseHormones.30: Intanga ngore zigenda zisubiza bidahoraho buhorobuhoro ibimenyetso vya hormone vyoherejwe n'ubwonko. Ivyo ni vyo bituma uruziga rutaba rusanzwe kandi bisobanura igituma ibimenyetso bishobora guhinduka ukwezi ku kundi.
MenopauseHormones.32: Birashoboka rwose kugira ibimenyetso bigaragara ukwezi kumwe, hanyuma hafi nta na kimwe ukurikira. Ntibidasanzwe: bigaragaza gusa guhinduka-hinduka kwa hormone muri iki gihe.
MenopauseHormones.33: Impinduka muri estrogen zishobora guhambira n'impinduka zitari nkeya:
MenopauseHormones.40: Ibi bimenyetso bishobora kugira ivyabitera bitari bike: ntibihora bihambiriye na hormone, kandi ukomera kwabyo kuratandukana cane hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
MenopauseHormones.41: Progesterone ikorwa gusa nyuma ya ovulation. Ariko mu gihe cya perimenopause, ovulation yayo ubwayo irarushiriza kutaba isanzwe — ico gituma ikorwa ryayo ritamenyekana neza.
MenopauseHormones.42: Uku kutaba gusanzwe gusobanura igice impinduka zibonwa mu ruziga: uko rumara kuratandukana, imihango rimwe na rimwe iba myinshi canke mike kuruta mbere.
MenopauseHormones.43: Hanze y'ihinduka-hinduka rya hormone, ibindi bintu bitari bike bizamo: ubwiza bw'ugusinzira, urugero rwo guhangayika, imibereho, n'itandukaniro ryihariye rya buri muntu.
MenopauseHormones.44: "Buri mugore aca muri iyi nzibacyuho mu buryo butandukanye."
MenopauseHormones.54: Uru rutonde ni urwo kumenyesha gusa: si isuzuma. Buri muntu agira uruvange rutandukanye rw'izi mpinduka.
MenopauseHormones.55: Kuvyuya mu ijoro kurashobora guhagarika ugusinzira, bigatera umunaniro n'ingorane yo gutumbera ejo — ishusho isanzwe muri iki gihe.
MenopauseHormones.57: Icumba gikonje, imyambaro yoroshe, n'akamenyero gashikamye ko kuryama bishobora gufasha kugabanya uko gukanguka.
MenopauseHormones.58: Ihinduka-hinduka rya hormone rishobora guhura n'impinduka mu mutima, ritari ryo risobanura byose: ugusinzira, guhangayika, impinduka mu buzima, n'ibimenyetso vy'umubiri na vyo bifise uruhara.
MenopauseHormones.60: Kumva ufise amarangamutima menshi muri iki gihe ntivuga ko hari ikitagenda: ni ivyo benshi baca muri vyo bishobora kugira ivyabitera bitari bike icarimwe.
MenopauseHormones.61: Urugero rwa hormone rushobora guhinduka cane kuva ku musi ujya ku wundi mu gihe cya perimenopause. Igipimo kimwe rero ntigihora gitanga ishusho yuzuye y'uko bimeze.
MenopauseHormones.63: Isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi riraterwa cane cane n'imyaka yawe, ibimenyetso vyawe, n'amateka y'uruziga rwawe — si umubare umwe gusa.
MenopauseHormones.64: Kwandika ivyo uciyemwo ukwezi ku kundi bigufasha kumenya ishusho yawe bwite aho kwigereranya n'abandi:
MenopauseHormones.73: Gukurikirana uruziga rwawe muri AWA bishobora kugufasha kumenya ishusho yawe bwite uko amezi ahita, nta mihati yiyongereye.
MenopauseHormones.74: Ibihe vyinshi muri ibi bisaba kubonana na muganga bisanzwe, uko ushaka:
MenopauseHormones.76: Ibimenyetso bigira ingaruka ikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri musi
MenopauseHormones.80: Impinduka zikomeye mu kuva amaraso kwawe
MenopauseHormones.82: Ingorane zijanye no kwuma kw'igitsina canke ubuzima bwawe bw'imibonano
MenopauseHormones.84: Kuva amaraso kwinshi cane canke kudasanzwe, naho, bikwiye kubwirwa vuba umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.
MenopauseHormones.85: Bitewe n'ukuntu bimeze, umuhinga ashobora gutanga uburyo butandukanye:
MenopauseHormones.87: Imyitozo y'umubiri, imirire, no kugenzura guhangayika n'ugusinzira.
MenopauseHormones.89: Uburyo bumwebumwe bushobora kwibanda ku bimenyetso bihariye, bitewe n'ukuntu bimeze.
MenopauseHormones.91: Iganirwaho na muganga igihe ihuye n'ukuntu uri n'ivyo ukeneye.
MenopauseHormones.92: Iyi myanzuro igumya kuba iy'umuntu ku giti ciwe: iraterwa n'amateka yawe, ibimenyetso vyawe, ingorane n'ivyo ukunda bwite.
MenopauseHormones.93: Impinduka za hormone ni igice kidatandukana cy'inzibacyuho ya menopause.
MenopauseHormones.94: Urugero rwa hormone rushobora guhinduka-hinduka cane mu gihe cya perimenopause, nta kugabanuka kugororotse neza.
MenopauseHormones.95: Ibimenyetso bitandukana cane hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi, no hagati y'ukwezi n'ukundi.
MenopauseHormones.96: Gukurikirana ibimenyetso vyawe bishobora kugufasha kumenya neza ishusho yawe bwite.
MenopauseHormones.97: Umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima ashobora kugushigikira nimba ibimenyetso bitangiye kugorana kugenzura.
MenopauseHormones.98: Ibikubiyemwo vyo kumenyesha. Iyi ngingo ntisubira inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Nimba ufise amakenga, saba inama umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.
MenopauseHormones.99: Hormone mu gihe cya menopause — AWA

MenopauseTransition.6: Ivyo bihinduka buhorobuhoro, imyaka imihango itarahagarara, n'ukuntu wogera kuri iki gice ufise ubusobanuro burushirije.
MenopauseTransition.13: Ivyiyumviro bitari ukuri bikunze ku bya menopause
MenopauseTransition.18: Perimenopause ni igihe c'inzibacyuho ya hormone kibanziriza menopause: gishobora gutangura imyaka myinshi imbere, isanzwe kuva mu myaka mirongo ine, urugero rwa estrogen ruhinduka-hinduka bidasanzwe.
MenopauseTransition.19: Menopause, naho, ni akanya kazwi: yemezwa nyuma y'amezi 12 akurikirana nta mihango, nta kindi gitera. Mu Bufaransa, iza ahagana mu myaka 51 ku rugero, naho iyi myaka itandukana mu buryo bw'umuhango hagati y'umugore n'uwundi.
MenopauseTransition.21: Buri mugore aca muri iyi nzibacyuho mu buryo butandukanye, mu gihe imara no mu bukomere bw'ibimenyetso. Kubivugako ku mugaragaro bigufasha kubyitegura neza.
MenopauseTransition.23: Kimwe mu bimenyetso vya mbere vya perimenopause kenshi ni impinduka mu muvuduko w'uruziga: inzira zishobora kuba ngufi, ndende, zitandukanijwe cane, canke kugira amaraso atandukanye ukwezi ku kundi.
MenopauseTransition.25: Kuva amaraso kwinshi cane, kuva amaraso kuba hafi cane, canke kuva amaraso nyuma y'umwaka nta mihango bisaba inama z'ubuvuzi, kuko bidafatwa nk'ibimenyetso bisanzwe vy'inzibacyuho.
MenopauseTransition.27: Kugabanuka no guhinduka-hinduka kwa estrogen na progesterone bishobora guhungabanya ugusinzira (kubona ibitotsi, gukanguka mu ijoro) kandi bishobora kuherekezwa n'uburakari, guhangayika, canke impinduka z'umutima zidasanzwe.
MenopauseTransition.28: Izi mpinduka zifise isobanuro nyaryo rya biyoloji: ntizerekana kubura ubushake canke ikibazo c'imitekerereze cihariye.
MenopauseTransition.30: Kugabanuka kwa estrogen kurashobora gutera kwuma kw'igitsina, rimwe na rimwe bigatera ukutamererwa neza canke ububabare mu gihe c'imibonano. Ubushake bushobora kandi guhinduka, bukiyongera canke bukagabanuka, bitewe n'umugore.
MenopauseTransition.32: Ibisubizo byoroshe birahari (amavuta yo koroshya, ayo gutuma igitsina gitose, imiti yo mu karere): kuvugana n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima bishobora kugufasha kubona igisubizo gikwiye, nta kujijinganya.
MenopauseTransition.34: Metabolism ishobora gutinda gatoyi muri iki gihe, kandi ukuntu ibinure bigabanijwe gukunda kwerekeza ku nda. Izi mpinduka ni zisanzwe kandi ntizishingiye ku bushake gusa.
MenopauseTransition.35: 6. Ivyiyumviro bitari ukuri bikunze ku bya menopause
MenopauseTransition.36: Menopause "iza icarimwe" — mu vy'ukuri, ibanzirizwa n'imyaka myinshi y'inzibacyuho (perimenopause)
MenopauseTransition.37: Ibimenyetso vyose bikomeye kuri bose — ukomera kwabyo gutandukana cane hagati y'umugore n'uwundi
MenopauseTransition.38: Nta co wokora — ibisubizo vyinshi, vya hormone canke ata, birahari kugira ngo bigabanye ibimenyetso bibangamira
MenopauseTransition.39: Ubuzima bw'imibonano burarangira — buhinduka, ariko bugumya gushoboka rwose kandi bugatanga umunezero iyo hakozwe ivyo bikwiye
MenopauseTransition.41: Impinduka nyinshi cane zasobanuwe hano ni ibigaragaza bisanzwe vy'inzibacyuho. Ariko, ibimenyetso bimwebimwe bisaba kwitabwaho vuba n'ubuvuzi.
MenopauseTransition.43: Kuva amaraso nyuma ya menopause yemejwe, ububabare budasanzwe mu nda yo hasi, ibimenyetso bihungabanya cane ubuzima bwa buri musi, canke amakenga yose adahera.
MenopauseTransition.45: Imirire ikungahaye kuri calcium na fibre
MenopauseTransition.51: Perimenopause na menopause ni ibice vy'umuhango, si indwara. Ibisubizo vyinshi birahari kugira ngo bigufashe gucamwo iyi nzibacyuho neza: umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima agumya kuba isoko nziza yo kubihuza n'ukuntu uri.

MenopauseTreatments.6: Imiti isubiza hormone n'ubundi buryo budakoresha hormone, kugira ngo ugufashe kwitegura kuganira n'umuganga wawe.
MenopauseTreatments.13: Umuti usubiza hormone muri menopause (HRT) usubiza ivyatakaye bya estrogen kandi ushobora kugabanya ibimenyetso bibangamira cane, nka hot flashes, ingorane zo gusinzira, canke kwuma kw'igitsina.
MenopauseTreatments.14: HRT irashobora kandi gufasha kurinda ubukomere bw'amagufa. Ariko, ntibereye buri kibazo: amateka bwite y'indwara zimwezimwe (indwara z'umutima n'imitsi, zimwe muri kanseri zishingiye kuri hormone) ashobora kugabanya ikoreshwa ryayo.
MenopauseTreatments.16: Ukuringaniza ivyiza n'ingorane vya HRT biraterwa n'imyaka yawe, igihe itangiriwe ugereranije na menopause, n'amateka yawe y'ubuvuzi: isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi rihariye rirakenewe imbere yo gufata icemezo cose.
MenopauseTreatments.17: Igihe HRT idashobotse canke itabereye, ubundi buryo burahari kugira ngo bufashe kugabanya ibimenyetso:
MenopauseTreatments.18: Ubuvuzi bw'imyifatire n'imitekerereze (bwo kugenzura guhangayika n'ugusinzira)
MenopauseTreatments.19: Imiti y'ibimera, ikurikiranwa n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima
MenopauseTreatments.20: Impinduka mu mibereho (imirire, imyitozo y'umubiri, ugusinzira)
MenopauseTreatments.21: Amavuta yo koroshya n'ayo gutuma igitsina gitose kuri kwuma kw'ibice vy'ibanga
MenopauseTreatments.23: Naho imiti y'ibimera nayo ikwiye inama z'umuhinga: “iy'umuhango” ntivuga “idafise ingaruka zishoboka” hamwe n'indi miti.
MenopauseTreatments.24: Gutegura ingingo zitari nyinshi imbere yo kubonana na muganga bigufasha gukoresha neza ikiganiro:
MenopauseTreatments.27: Ivyo ukunda (hormone canke ata, igihe utekereza)
MenopauseTreatments.28: Ibibazo vyawe n'ivyo ufise ubwoba — ntutinye kubibaza
MenopauseTreatments.30: Hormone canke ata, nta muti ubereye bose: ikikubereye giterwa n'ukuntu uri, gisuzumwa n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.

MenstruationPurity.6: Gusobanukirwa isano iri hagati y'uruziga n'imimerere y'isuku y'idini, kugira ngo ushike kuri iki gihe ufise ubusobanuro burushirije.
MenstruationPurity.8: Ibi bikubiyemwo ni vyo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga bafise ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibihano by'idini bihariye.
MenstruationPurity.16: Mu muhango w'Isilamu, isuku y'idini (tahara) ivuga imimerere ikenewe kugira ngo hakorwe ibikorwa bimwebimwe vy'ugusenga, nk'isengesho. Ntivuga isuku mu buryo busanzwe bwa buri musi, ariko imimerere yihariye izwi na fiqh, ihinduka bitewe n'ibice vy'uruziga rw'umugore.
MenstruationPurity.17: Mu gihe c'imihango, umugore ntasabwa ibikorwa bimwebimwe vy'ugusenga, cane cane isengesho n'igisibo ca Ramadan, bishobora gusubirwamwo nyuma. Uku kudasabwa kuzwi nk'ukworoherezwa, si igihano.
MenstruationPurity.18: Ivyo bikomeza gushoboka mu gihe c'imihango
MenstruationPurity.20: Kumva canke gusoma ibikubiyemwo vyo kwigisha n'ivy'umwuka
MenstruationPurity.24: Ibintu bimwebimwe (nko gusoma Quran mu buryo butaziguye canke kwinjira mu musigiti) bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishure ry'amategeko y'idini; ni vyiza kwiyambaza igitekerezo ukurikiza bisanzwe canke umuhanga afise ubushobozi kuri ivyo bibazo bihariye.
MenstruationPurity.25: Iherezo ry'imihango ryerekana isubira rya buhorobuhoro ry'imimerere y'isuku y'idini. Mu mubiri, ivyo bihuye no guhagarara kw'amaraso, ikimenyetso amashure atandukanye y'abahanga ashobora gusobanura n'utuntu duto dutandukanye.
MenstruationPurity.27: Gusobanukirwa ibice vy'uruziga bigufasha kumenya neza akanya imihango irangiriye koko.
MenstruationPurity.28: Iyo ico kimenyetso kibonetse, ghusl (kwiyuhagira gukomeye) iratuma hasubirwa mu isuku y'idini no gusubira mu bikorwa vy'ugusenga vyari vyahagaritswe.
MenstruationPurity.29: Ghusl ni ukwiyuhagira gukomeye kw'idini gusaba koza umubiri wose ufise intego yo kwisukura. Irangiza kudasabwa kandi ituma isengesho risubira bisanzwe, bitaba ngombwa gusubiramwo amasengesho yasibiwe mu gihe c'imihango.
MenstruationPurity.31: Uburyo nyabwo ghusl ikorwamwo bushobora gutandukana gatoyi bitewe n'ishure ry'amategeko y'idini rikurikizwa.
MenstruationPurity.33: Nimba utazi intambwe nyazo zikurikizwa mu ishure ryawe, umuntu wizeye canke umuhanga afise ubushobozi azokubisobanurira neza.
MenstruationPurity.34: Ni ibisanzwe kugira amakenga ku gihe imihango yarangiriye koko, cane cane igihe amaraso agabanuka buhorobuhoro aho guhagarara gitunguranye.
MenstruationPurity.36: Rabira ko nta maraso na make asigaye, si ukugabanuka gusa
MenstruationPurity.37: Reka igihe gihagije gihite imbere yo gufata umwanzuro ko imihango yarangiye
MenstruationPurity.38: Shingira ku kurabira kuboneka kuruta ku mvugo gusa
MenstruationPurity.39: Ibuka umuvuduko wawe usanzwe, ushobora gutandukana hagati y'uruziga n'urundi
MenstruationPurity.41: Mu bihe vyo kuva amaraso kumara igihe canke kutari kwo bisanzwe, canke amakenga adahera, ivyo bihe bikwiye kuganirwaho n'umuhanga afise ubushobozi, ashobora kukuyobora bijanye n'ukuntu uri. Ibi bikubiyemwo bigumya kuba vyo kumenyesha kandi ntibisubira ubuyobozi bw'idini buhariye.
MenstruationPurity.43: Ibi bimenyetso ni ibisubizo rusangi vyo kwigisha. Buri kibazo gishobora kugira umwihariko waco: igihe hari amakenga, kuganira n'umuhanga afise ubushobozi bikomeza kuba isoko nziza y'igisubizo gikwiye ukuntu uri.

MiscarriageFertility.1: Ububyazi no kugerageza kandi nyuma y'igihombo
MiscarriageFertility.6: Igihe n'uburyo bwo gutekereza ku kugerageza kandi, ku muvuduko wawe n'ufise icizere cuzuye.
MiscarriageFertility.13: Ububyazi busanzwe busubira hakiri kare nko mu ruziga rukurikira inda yakuwemwo hakiri kare. Ovulation irashobora no kuba imihango yawe itaragaragara.
MiscarriageFertility.15: Bitewe n'igice c'igihombo, igihe co koroherwa mu mubiri gishobora gutandukana gatoyi hagati y'ikibazo n'ikindi.
MiscarriageFertility.16: Abahinga benshi bafata ko nta mpamvu yo gutegereza inzira zitari nke imbere yo kugerageza kandi, keretse umuganga wawe canke umubyaza akugiriye inama itandukanye.
MiscarriageFertility.18: Ububyazi kenshi busubira vuba, nko mu ruziga rukurikira.
MiscarriageFertility.20: Igihe kirushiriza kuba kirekire co koroherwa gishobora gusabwa n'ikipe y'ubuvuzi.
MiscarriageFertility.21: Kumva witeguye, mu mubiri no mu marangamutima, bigumya kuba icerekezo gikuru — kuruta igihe cose co mu nyigisho.
MiscarriageFertility.23: Kumva witeguye muri wewe ubwawe ni ngombwa nka kumwe no koroherwa kw'umubiri.
MiscarriageFertility.25: Uruziga rusanzwe n'ukumva umerewe neza ni ibimenyetso vyiza.
MiscarriageFertility.27: Kuvugana n'uwo muri kumwe bishobora kugufasha gutera imbere ku muvuduko umwe.
MiscarriageFertility.28: Imbere yo kugerageza kandi, kubonana na muganga bishobora kugufasha gutera imbere ufise amahoro menshi:
MiscarriageFertility.30: Ikiganiro n'umuhinga kigufasha gusubira ku vyabaye.
MiscarriageFertility.32: Bitewe n'ukuntu bimeze, ibindi bizamini bishobora gutangwa.
MiscarriageFertility.34: Gukurikiranwa noneho kurashobora kugushigikira utuje ukigerageza kandi.
MiscarriageFertility.36: Inda imwe yakuwemwo isanzwe itavuga ikibazo c'ububyazi. Ikipe yawe y'ubuvuzi igumya kuba yo ibereye cane gusubiza ibibazo vyawe bwite.
MiscarriageFertility.37: Ububyazi busanzwe busubira hakiri kare nko mu ruziga rukurikira inda yakuwemwo hakiri kare.
MiscarriageFertility.38: Abahinga benshi bafata ko nta mpamvu yo gutegereza inzira zitari nke, keretse bagiriwe inama itandukanye.
MiscarriageFertility.39: Kumva witeguye, mu mubiri no mu marangamutima, bigumya kuba icerekezo gikuru.
MiscarriageFertility.40: Gukurikiranwa n'ubuvuzi bishobora kugushigikira no kugarurira amahoro imbere yo kugerageza kandi.
MiscarriageFertility.41: Ibikubiyemwo vyo kumenyesha. Iyi ngingo ntisubira inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Umuganga wawe canke umubyaza agumya kuba icerekezo c'ukuntu uri.
MiscarriageFertility.42: Ububyazi no kugerageza kandi nyuma y'igihombo — AWA

MiscarriageGrief.0: NYUMA Y'INDA YAKUWEMWO • UGUSHIGIKIRWA MU MARANGAMUTIMA
MiscarriageGrief.6: Nta buryo bwiza bwo kubicamwo. Buri wese abicamwo mu buryo bwiwe, ku muvuduko wiwe.
MiscarriageGrief.14: Akababaro, uburakari, canke kumva ufise ubusa ni ibisubizo bisanzwe kuri iki gihombo, uko igice c'igitigiri cari kimeze kwose. Ivyo wumva bikwiye kwemerwa.
MiscarriageGrief.16: Nta buryo bwiza canke bubi bwo kubicamwo. Buri marangamutima wumva ni yo.
MiscarriageGrief.17: Ushobora kumva rimwe canke menshi muri ayo, rimwe na rimwe yose icarimwe:
MiscarriageGrief.19: Umubabaro ushobora kuza ugatuma, rimwe na rimwe bitunguranye.
MiscarriageGrief.21: Kuri wewe, ukuntu bimeze, canke kumva hari akarengane — kandi nta co guhagarika umutima kirimwo.
MiscarriageGrief.23: Kumva ufise ubusa canke urujijo ku vyabaye gusa.
MiscarriageGrief.24: Kwiha igihe, nta gukanda canke kugereranya, ni igice ca ngombwa c'ukuvurwa kw'umutima.
MiscarriageGrief.26: Nta gukanda canke igihe ntarengwa co “kumererwa neza.”
MiscarriageGrief.28: Buri kababaro karihariye; nta buryo bwiza bwo kukacamwo.
MiscarriageGrief.30: Kwandika canke kuvuga ivyo wumva bishobora gufasha koroshya uburemere bw'amarangamutima yawe.
MiscarriageGrief.31: Kuvugana n'umuntu uri hafi yawe, itsinda ry'ugushigikirana, canke umuhinga bishobora gufasha koroshya ubu buremere. Dore ukuntu abagukunda bashobora gufasha:
MiscarriageGrief.33: Umviriza nta kurenganya, naho utagira amagambo ahebuje
MiscarriageGrief.34: Irinde gufata uko bivye nk'ibidafise agaciro (“si vyinshi”, “ushobora kugerageza kandi”)
MiscarriageGrief.35: Tanga kuba uhari aho gutanga ibisubizo
MiscarriageGrief.36: Ukomeze kubaza uko ameze mu byumweru bikurikira
MiscarriageGrief.37: Ibimenyetso bimwebimwe bishobora kwerekana ko ubufasha bw'umuhinga bwoba bufasha:
MiscarriageGrief.39: Akababaro kamara igihe kirekire kandi kakarushiriza gukomera aho koroha
MiscarriageGrief.42: Ivyiyumviro bibangamira canke umubabaro ukomeye biragaragara
MiscarriageGrief.44: Umubyaza, umuganga, umuhinga w'imitekerereze, canke itsinda ry'ugushigikirana barashobora kukumva no kugushigikira, nta kurenganya.
MiscarriageGrief.46: Gusaba ubufasha si ikimenyetso c'intege nke — ni uburyo bwo kwiyitaho muri iki gihe.
MiscarriageGrief.47: Nta buryo bwiza canke bubi bwo gucamwo ivyo wacitsemwo.
MiscarriageGrief.48: Akababaro, uburakari, canke kumva ufise ubusa ni ibisubizo bisanzwe.
MiscarriageGrief.49: Kwiha igihe, nta gukanda canke kugereranya, ni igice c'ukuvurwa kw'umutima.
MiscarriageGrief.50: Kuvugana n'umuntu uri hafi yawe, itsinda ry'ugushigikirana, canke umuhinga bishobora gufasha koroshya ubu buremere.
MiscarriageGrief.51: Ibikubiyemwo vyo kumenyesha. Iyi ngingo ntisubira inama z'umuhinga. Nimba uciye mu gihe kigoye, ntutinye kuvugana n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.
